subject: ONE stocky pangolin in a grey office suit and a blue tie, bronze scales, long curved claws, a lanyard round his neck, never held in one pose
second_characters: hurrying office workers with coffee cups and ONE stern security beetle in a cap, crossing the lens in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE glass turnstile gate with two sliding glass doors and a round card reader that glows green or red
props.small: TWO identical white keycards; A SWARM of paper scraps

environment: a busy bright office lobby at noon, glass walls, potted palms, crowds, no empty wall
lighting: bright sunny noon daylight; at 2.20 the reader flashes from green to red
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the pangolin fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, his face never under a quarter of it. The camera orbits him on a hard arc in EVERY beat, close, never parks, new shot size every beat. Office workers, cups and paper scraps sweep across the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, speech beats too. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: flat low male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.85, then the turnstile and the beetle carry it
audio.lip_sync: the pangolin himself speaks, mouth opening on every syllable, brows and jaw alive
audio.pronunciation: PER-vy LO-gin pra-pus-TIL. fta-ROY, KA-zhet-sya, VY-cherk-nul me-NYA iz fsekh SPIS-kov

timeline.a: chest-up, mouth working, he slaps the first white keycard on the reader with one long claw, it glows green and the glass doors whoosh open, his tie flapping, a worker sweeping across the lens
he swings round and slaps the second white keycard on the same reader the same way, a coffee cup flying across the lens
the reader flashes red, the glass doors snap shut on his tail and he skids back hard, paper scraps whipping across the lens
waist-up, facing the lens, mouth working, he tugs his pinched tail free with both claws, a worker hurrying across the lens
waist-up, facing the lens, mouth working, he jams his lanyard badge into the reader, it chews it to strips at his chest, scraps sweeping across the lens
the security beetle grabs his collar and spins him round, he curls into a tight scaly ball, workers whipping across the lens
the beetle bowls the scaly ball back out through the lobby, it bounces off a potted palm, leaves flying across the lens
the ball thumps to a stop and he unrolls on the floor, shredded strips raining across the lens
he sits up and pulls the two identical keycards from his breast pocket, a coffee cup flying across the lens
he tucks both cards back into his suit pocket and straightens his tie, workers sweeping across the lens
he turns his face to the lens with a flat stare and blinks once, ONE shredded strip sliding off his snout

must_appear: 0.00 first keycard, green reader, doors open; 1.50 the identical second keycard on the same reader; 2.20 red reader, doors shut on his tail; 9.40 his flat stare at the lens
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, logos, subtitles, watermark, a horizontal 16:9 picture, letterbox, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a conveyor belt, a parked camera, a still or empty background, standing in place, wide shot, a small distant hero, night, dark scene, a hero back to the camera, a closed mouth while speaking, offscreen narration, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.85, English speech, foreign accent, a human guard
